title: On Global-in-time Solutions of Incompressible MHD Equations with Small Alfvén Numbers
summary: In 1965 Kraichnan pointed out that a sufficiently strong background magnetic field, i.e. the case of small Alfvén number, will reduce the nonlinear interaction and inhibit the formation of strong gradients in the magnetohydrodynamic (abbr. MHD) system with $μ=ν\geqslant 0$, where $μ$ and $ν$ are the coefficients of kinematic viscosity and resistivity resp.. This means that the MHD system with $μ=ν\geqslant 0$ admits global-in-time large perturbation solutions with small Alfvén numbers.
